transcript.text: Thank you both for raising these important points before we move forward. Kai, thank you for flagging your approved communication accommodation — I want to make sure that's properly factored into the plan. An agenda shared at least 48 hours in advance and a written channel for submitting comments are both things I can commit to incorporating. Lena, thank you for disclosing those observations about interruptions during retrospectives. That's directly relevant to why these sessions have been tense, and I agree it needs to be addressed in how we structure things going forward. I'd like to hear from both of you now on what specifically would make the next six weeks workable, with these points in mind. Kai, could you go ahead and share what you need, and then Lena, I'd like to hear from you as well?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. With the accommodation in mind, here's what would make the next six weeks workable for me: First, having the agenda at least 48 hours in advance lets me review the topics and prepare my thoughts rather than having to process everything in real time during a tense meeting. Second, having a written channel for submitting comments means I can contribute things I might not get to say in the room — especially if interruptions are happening, as Lena mentioned. Beyond that, I think having some structure to the discussion — like a speaking order or a facilitator role — would help with the tension Lena's observations point to. And tying back to your six-week review commitment, it would be helpful to check in at the end of the six weeks on whether these changes are actually working, not just whether we did them.

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara, and thanks, Kai — I appreciate you raising both the accommodation and the structure suggestions. Building on all of that, here's what would make the next six weeks workable for me: First, I think the three interruptions I observed need to be addressed directly. A speaking order or facilitator role, like Kai suggested, would help, but I'd also want to see some kind of formal participation record — not just notes, but an actual log of who spoke and whether interruptions occurred — so we can track whether the pattern is improving over the six weeks. Second, given that I held onto these observations instead of recording them, I think we need a clear, low-friction way for anyone to flag issues like interruptions either during or after the meeting without having to bring it up in front of everyone. Third, I'd like the six-week review Mara mentioned to specifically include reviewing whether the interruption pattern has changed, using whatever records or observations we collect during that period. And finally, I'd want to enter my past observations into the meeting record as part of this process, so we have a baseline to compare against at the six-week mark.

decisions.meeting_format: Structured discussion with a designated facilitator role and a speaking order for each agenda item

commitments.detail: Retrospective agenda will be shared at least 48 hours in advance for all six weeks, per Kai's approved communication accommodation.
A written channel will be established for submitting comments before or after retrospectives, available to all team members.
Each retrospective will have a designated facilitator and a defined speaking order for each agenda item to reduce interruptions and tension.
A formal participation record will be kept for each retrospective, logging who spoke and noting any interruptions observed.
A clear, low-friction mechanism will be established for anyone to flag issues like interruptions during or after a meeting without having to raise them in front of the full group.
Lena's three previously observed interruptions will be entered into the meeting record as a baseline for comparison.

At the end of the six-week period, a documented review will be conducted covering: whether the format changes were implemented as planned, whether they are working as experienced by the team, and specifically whether the interruption pattern has changed compared to the baseline.
